_doc: The engine's one self-owned purpose (SPEC_DATSPET_AI_ENGINE §3.1). It exists so the admin's Test-configuration button has something real to call: install a key, press it, and watch a row land in ai_usage with real tokens and a derived cost. It carries no pet knowledge — `tier: fast` (identifying nothing is not hard), a two-token prompt, no image, no template variables — so shipping it does not smuggle a product concern into the engine. output_schema uses only structured-output-supported keywords (no minimum/maximum/minLength/maxLength — the API silently ignores those, so the purpose validator rejects them; §11).
description: A no-op probe that proves the AI engine is wired: it resolves a model, makes one real structured-output call, and records a usage row.
system_prompt: You are a connectivity probe for the DatsPet AI engine. Answer only in the required JSON shape.
user_prompt_template: Reply with ok set to true and echo set to the single word pong.
